decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed single storey side and infill extensions to Marjory Kinnon School, Bedfont, by way of their size, scale, design and location would not represent an obtrusive design and would not have an adverse impact upon the general amenity of the immediate locality.  They would complement the sites exiting use as an educational facility while respecting the open, spacious nature of the greenbelt area within which it is located and are therefore in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Developments) ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable Development in the Green Belt) C.2.1 (Educational Facilities) and ENV-N1.12 (Retention of Playing Fields) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on site outside the hours of 8am to 6pm Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays.
description: Erection of single storey side extension to existing school and internal alterations.
